description: This file defines the Browser class and related classes for managing browser instances, contexts, and server communication within the Playwright core project. It includes methods for creating contexts, handling downloads, videos, and server start/stop operations.

classes.name: Browser
classes.description: Abstract class representing a browser instance, managing contexts, downloads, videos, and server communication.

classes.name: BrowserServer
classes.description: Handles starting and stopping the browser server, including socket communication and registry management.

methods.name: doCreateNewContext
methods.description: Abstract method to create a new browser context with specified options.

methods.name: contexts
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve all active browser contexts.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Abstract method to check if the browser is still connected.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Abstract method to get the browser version.

methods.name: userAgent
methods.description: Abstract method to get the user agent string.

methods.name: newContext
methods.description: Creates a new browser context with validation and optional proxy/certificates handling.

methods.name: newContextForReuse
methods.description: Reuses or creates a new context based on provided parameters.

methods.name: contextForReuse
methods.description: Returns the current context set for reuse.

methods.name: _downloadCreated
methods.description: Tracks a new download associated with a page.

methods.name: _downloadFilenameSuggested
methods.description: Updates the suggested filename for a download.

methods.name: _downloadFinished
methods.description: Marks a download as finished and reports completion.

methods.name: _videoStarted
methods.description: Starts recording a video for a page.

methods.name: _takeVideo
methods.description: Retrieves and removes a recorded video artifact.

methods.name: startServer
methods.description: Starts the browser server and registers it.

methods.name: stopServer
methods.description: Stops the browser server and unregisters it.

methods.name: _didClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the browser closes.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the browser, optionally with a reason.

methods.name: killForTests
methods.description: Kills the browser process for testing purposes.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the browser server, creates communication channels, and registers the server.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the browser server and cleans up resources.
